eas_text: A civil authority has issued A 911 TELEPHONE OUTAGE EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Talbot, MD; at 1:56 PM on AUG 19, 2016 Effective until 2:56 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Talbot County Department Emergency Services recently received information from Sprint in reference to failed attempts to contact 9-1-1. Sprint is trying to rectify the situation ASAP. If you are in Talbot County,  have Sprint as a carrier, and need to contact 911 please call our non- emergency number 410-822-0095. Please follow local media and social media for continuing updates.
